said on Wednesday that its subsidiary, Shandong Sunrise Technology, completed the first phase of a RMB 343.5M ($51.2M) turnkey contract with Shandong Fusion New Material and received RMB 61.8M ($9.2M) in full payment.
The completed phase covers design and technical consulting for artificial graphite and silicon-carbon anode production lines.
The RMB 61.8M ($9.2M) payment represents about 18% of the contract's total RMB 343.5M ($51.2M) value, which was awarded in June 2026.
The remaining work includes equipment manufacturing and delivery, installation, commissioning, and trial production, testing, operator training, spare parts, and a 12-month warranty period.
The project will culminate in trial production and final acceptance at the customer's facility in Jinan, China.
Following the announcement, the E-Power stock traded ~6.14% higher at ~$7.33.

title: E-Power stock surges 6% as $51.2M Anode contract moves ahead
